info.title: Tapstitch Open Platform API
info.description:
The Tapstitch Open Platform API is a RESTful JSON API.

Base URL is `https://openapi.tapstitch.com`.

## Authentication

Create a private token in the [Developer Portal](/developers/tokens), then send that token on every API request:

```
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Replace `{token}` with the token issued to you. Private tokens may have an expiry and cannot be refreshed. The portal shows your **`user_id`** (Tapstitch account ID); rate limits and account webhook delivery use this id.



**Integration note:** Partner API calls use **`Authorization: Bearer`** only. Portal sign-in is for humans managing tokens in the browser, not for server-to-server integration.

## Webhooks

Configure a callback URL in the [Developer Portal](/developers/webhooks) or via `GET/POST/DELETE /v1/webhooks`.
Read or toggle one event with `GET/POST/DELETE /v1/webhooks/{eventType}`.

Configure webhooks for the authenticated account (`user_id`). Requires `webhooks/read` to read configuration and `webhooks` to create, update, or disable it.

### Event types

Subscribe using the wire names below (`body.type`). The table is generated from the backend exposed catalog — the same list as `GET /v1/webhooks/events` and the portal checkboxes. Names that are not listed cannot be subscribed.

| Type | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `order_created` | order | Order was created |
| `order_paid` | order | Order payment was completed |
| `order_in_production` | order | Order was locked for production |
| `order_fulfilled` | order | All items in the order were shipped |
| `order_canceled` | order | Order was canceled |
| `shipment_shipped` | shipment | Shipment was shipped |
| `shipment_delivered` | shipment | Shipment was delivered |
| `design_task_created` | design | Design processing task was accepted and is now being processed |
| `design_task_succeeded` | design | Design processing completed successfully |
| `design_task_failed` | design | Design processing failed |
| `design_copied` | design | Design was copied |
| `design_deleted` | design | Design was deleted |




## Idempotent requests

`Idempotency-Key` is optional on supported write endpoints. Include a unique key for each intended operation, and reuse it when retrying the same request. Without a key, the request is processed without this idempotency protection. Do not reuse a key for a different operation or payload.

```
Idempotency-Key: 3f5b6ebf-143c-4da5-8d0f-fb8553bfd85d
```

| Situation | Response |
| --- | --- |
| First success | Cached ~24h |
| Retry same key after success | Replays the stored response while the record is retained |
| Same key still processing | **409** (`#errors/conflict`) — retry with the same key |
| New write | New key |

When provided: length **1–128**; charset **`[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`**. Scoped by `user_id` + write scope + path. Supported endpoints show this optional header in their parameters.

Validation failures (**400**, `#errors/validation-error`) set `source.header` to `Idempotency-Key`. Concurrent use (**409**, `#errors/conflict`) uses the same header name in `detail` only (no `source`). Exact `detail` strings:

| HTTP | `type` fragment | `detail` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **400** | `#errors/validation-error` | `Idempotency-Key length must be between 1 and 128.` |
| **400** | `#errors/validation-error` | `Idempotency-Key must match [A-Za-z0-9._:-].` |
| **409** | `#errors/conflict` | `Idempotency-Key is already in use. Retry with the same key.` |

```json
{
  "type": "https://developers.tapstitch.com/developers/docs#errors/validation-error",
  "status": 400,
  "title": "Validation Error",
  "detail": "Idempotency-Key must match [A-Za-z0-9._:-].",
  "instance": "request/01HXYZ...",
  "source": { "header": "Idempotency-Key" }
}
```

## Rate limits

Rate limits are shared across API tokens belonging to the same account (`user_id`). The quota below applies to rate-limited endpoints:

| Quota | Window | Policy header |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1000** requests | **60** seconds | `X-RateLimit-Policy: 1000;w=60;` |

Use the `X-RateLimit-*` response headers to check your quota. If you receive HTTP **429**, wait for the duration indicated by `Retry-After` before retrying.

## Errors

Failures use [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457.html) Problem Details rather than the legacy `{code, result, error}` envelope. Content-Type is `application/problem+json`:

```json
{
  "type": "https://developers.tapstitch.com/developers/docs#errors/not-found",
  "status": 404,
  "title": "Not Found",
  "detail": "The resource that you tried to access does not exist.",
  "instance": "request/01HXYZ..."
}
```

`type` uses a stable error fragment (`#errors/{slug}`). `instance` is `request/{X-Request-Id}` (send it with support tickets). Validation errors may add `source.pointer` / `source.parameter` / `source.header` and `valid_values`. 5xx responses never include stack traces.

| Status | Typical cause |
| --- | --- |
| **400** | Bad request / invalid JSON / validation |
| **401** | Missing / invalid / expired / revoked token |
| **403** | Missing required scope or resource access denied |
| **404** | Unknown path or resource |
| **405** | HTTP method not allowed |
| **409** | Conflict (e.g. `Idempotency-Key` still in use — retry same key) |
| **429** | Rate limit exceeded |
| **500** | Unexpected server error |
| **501** | Endpoint not implemented yet |

## Scopes

Write scopes also grant read access. For example, `orders` also grants `orders/read` access.

Scopes ending in `/read` grant read-only access. Scopes without this suffix grant read and write access to that resource.

Catalog endpoints require an account-level token with `catalog/read`. There is no catalog write scope.

| Scope | Permission in Portal |
| --- | --- |
| `catalog/read` | View catalog products |
| `orders/read` | View all orders |
| `orders` | View and manage all orders |
| `webhooks/read` | View webhooks |
| `webhooks` | View and manage webhooks |
| `designs/read` | View designs |
| `designs` | View and manage designs |


The token must include the scope declared by each endpoint or its corresponding read and write scope.
